sentences.en: The company recalled all the baby food made in July.
sentences.zh: 公司召回了7月份生产的所有婴儿食品。

sentences.en: Look at the cute little baby sleeping in the cradle.
sentences.zh: 看看摇篮里睡着的那个可爱的小宝宝。

sentences.en: The mother used her own milk to nourish the baby.
sentences.zh: 妈妈用自己的母乳喂养孩子。

senses.zh: 把…当作婴孩看待，娇养；纵容
